scope: Corollary 5.2 (Inverse restriction rank) of the manuscript “The sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric Bernoulli matrices” (preprints/The-sharp-exponential-rate-of-singularity-for-symmetric-Bernoulli-matrices-October-3-2026/symmetric-bernoulli-singularity.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 239 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8dfe5c0b8a0ca85c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every pair of fixed constants D, A > 0, typically for nonsingular binary matrices B of size m ∈ IN , simultaneously for every rational W ⊆ Rm with H(W) ≤ exp(NℓD), rank(B−1 |W ) ≥ dim W − Nℓ−A . Here B−1|W is the restriction of the bilinear form with matrix B−1, rather than the restriction of its associated linear map. The exceptional probability is uniform in m, as in Proposition 5.1.
